title: Let Them Down Easy! Contextual Effects of LLM Guardrails on User Perceptions and Preferences
reasoning: The paper uses 'Ethical Judgments' (measuring 'ethical appropriateness' and 'expectations') as one of its three core conceptual categories for evaluating user perceptions of LLM guardrails.
